# Byline Bancorp, Inc. and Illinois State Bancorp, Inc. Announce Definitive Merger Agreement


October 06, 2026


Byline Bancorp, Inc.


Acquired Banks


Media and Press


-
-
-
-


Today, we announced that Byline Bancorp, Inc. (“Byline”) (NYSE: BY), and Illinois State Bancorp, Inc. and its two banks – First Nations Bank and Bank of Bourbonnais have entered into a definitive merger agreement. For additional details, please see the[official press release](https://www.bylinebancorp.com/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Byline-Bancorp-Inc--and-Illinois-State-Bancorp-Inc--Announce-Definitive-Merger-Agreement/default.aspx) on our Investor’s page.
